The lower platforms are gates (retract) on the bottom crossing. Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, X, T.

Bridges: S pockets, M, Y, K, T.

maps.name: Switchyard

Bridges: S pockets, S / M / L, X, T, L. Inward Last Stand keeps the drawbridge.
